scope: Each point is one terminal attempt, with no averaging, pooled percentiles or fitted lines. Goodput is accepted confirmations within the fixed arrival window. Scheduled-to-confirmed conditional accepted p99 includes client queueing and drain, but excludes not-sent, rejected, errored and final-unknown arrivals. A dagger marks unavailable all-offered accepted p99; no lost request receives a finite latency. Invalid points are client-reported diagnostics, not validated business success or capacity. The complete physical-session/network-owner/dispatch arrangement changes; logical in-flight and total FIFO remain fixed. Finite shared-host windows establish neither sustained production capacity nor a bare matching-engine ceiling.
